papers.title: Acute hyperglycemia after intracerebral hemorrhage is associated with 90-day cognitive impairment.
papers.reason: The paper concerns clinical cognitive impairment after hemorrhage but provides no stated focus on executive-function mechanisms, computational modelling, or digital biomarkers.

papers.title: A novel approach to dyslexia detection: combining EEG data and cognitive tasks with advanced machine learning.
papers.reason: This is a close multimodal assessment match combining paired EEG and cognitive screening data for clinical classification, with spectral findings linked to working-memory deficits.

papers.title: Spinal cord injury is associated with reduced cognitive capacity to self-regulate, organise and adapt to new situations.
papers.reason: The study directly identifies selective executive-function deficits under higher cognitive demand using fluency, abstraction, and reverse digit-span tasks in a clinical population.

papers.title: Cognitive and motor profiles in biologically defined Parkinson's and Alzheimer's disease
papers.reason: The study uses biological markers to predict broad longitudinal cognitive decline in Parkinson's disease but does not specifically analyze executive-function processes or digital assessment.

papers.title: Neurophysiological Evidence of Enhanced Cognitive Control Following Auditory Control Enhancement (ACE) Therapy: A Pilot RCT in Schizophrenia-Spectrum Disorders with Persistent Auditory Hallucinations.
papers.reason: The pilot trial directly measures proactive cognitive control and selective attention with AX-CPT and EEG, reporting intervention-related changes in ASSR modulation and beta desynchronization.

papers.title: Modified shuffle Net-DCNN architecture with cepstral and spectral feature for epileptic seizure detection using EEG signal.
papers.reason: This EEG classification paper focuses on detecting epileptic seizures and does not investigate executive function, cognitive mechanisms, or cognitive-status assessment.

papers.title: The impact of test announcements on subtitle reliance and video comprehension: The role of vocabulary size and working memory
papers.reason: The eye-tracking experiment provides behavioral evidence about how working-memory capacity and anticipatory task demands influence visual attention and subtitle reliance.

papers.title: Mild Cognitive Impairment Diagnosis and Care Algorithms and the Role of Digital Interventions: Expert Consensus
papers.reason: The consensus discusses digital cognitive assessment and early MCI identification broadly but offers no specific executive-function model or validated multimodal biomarker method.

papers.title: Dual Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation Modulates Hierarchical Functional Network Organization in Post‐Stroke Cognitive Impairment: A Randomized Controlled Trial
papers.reason: The trial links DLPFC stimulation and improvements in attention, Stroop, and trail-making performance to changes in regional activity, connectivity, and global functional-network topology.
